notes.title: 0.99.0 🎉 Almost Full Release! New Maps, Design, Resources, Buildings, Features
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and a huge thank you for your support throughout this time! I’m excited to announce that I’ve released the full gameplay of the game!

After a few weeks of testing and fixes, I’ll press the full release button on Steam once the new screenshots and trailers are ready. In the meantime, you can enjoy this update!

I’d love it if you could share your thoughts in the game reviews—your feedback will be a huge support for the project before the full launch!

You can play older versions of the game by switching to the beta branch in the application settings, for example, to version 0.9.7.

This MASSIVE update brings you a brand-new gaming experience!

 A final mission with rocket launches;
 A map six times larger with a new game design;
 Enemy camps;
 New resources, resource limits;
 Resources now need to be transported from all corners of the map;
 New buildings;
 Outposts;
 Improved balance;
 Enhanced environmental design;
 Optimization improvements;
 Build multiple colonies at once, set up outposts for resource collection, capture enemy camps, and establish supply routes!


Launching the Space Station
The final mission has been added! Completing it will bring a sense of achievement as you finish the map. Your goal is to develop a high-tech colony and launch three shuttles carrying components for an orbital station! These launches will require rare resources. Completing a single map up to this final stage will take 3-5 hours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/56e5a842030405db2dfe68107cb6c124d731dcab.png

After completing all missions, you can continue playing in free mode.

New Map Design
All maps have been completely reworked! They are now significantly larger and designed to encourage the creation of multiple colonies and outposts.

You’ll need to set up logistics routes between them and use faster ships to deliver resources directly to your base.

New maps:
Great River
A continent divided by several wide river channels.

Islands
Numerous small islands requiring a complex logistics network.

Icy Ridges
Colonies and logistics must be built between narrow mountain passes.

Canyons
A mix of plateaus and valleys, offering strategic choices for colony placement.

Improved Terrain and Performance
Shaders for terrain rendering and resource overlays have been rewritten, improving visual quality.
FPS boost by 15%!

Maps now feature multiple biomes and unique visual designs in some locations.

New Resources and Buildings
Don’t worry—I haven’t just stretched the game! Instead, I’ve expanded the number of resources, buildings, and mechanics. Old production chains have also been improved and refined.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/86bfca3ae2bacf9fc33b023415ad4990c514f8e1.png

New extractable resources:

 Natural gas
 Nuclear materials

New ship-mined resources:

 Silicon
 Platinum
 Gold
 Copper

New crafted resources:

 Hydrogen
 Carbon
 Electronics
 Superconductors

New factories:

 Gas extractor
 Nuclear extractor
 Hydrogen factory
 Electronics factory
 Superconductors factory

Resource Limits and Outposts
Each resource deposit now has a finite reserve that gradually replenishes, preventing players from stationing multiple high-level mining ships in a single spot. You'll have to search for new deposits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/692f6576ec62a3ff505fb96b913890ac08ba5703.png

Outposts increase the total resources available in a deposit, boosting extraction rates. Each deposit can have up to two outposts of one type:

 Geological Survey Outpost
 Mining Outpost

The resource display on the map has been improved, now showing limits and replenishment rates for deposits.

Oblivion Camps
Enemy camps now appear on maps with different threat levels and Oblivion ships that regenerate over time. Waves of enemy ships will now launch from these camps, meaning attacks will come from multiple directions.

Clearing a camp raises the Oblivion threat level in the region, increasing the number and strength of enemy ships.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/44d027542b8b87821725ebff4d9eec807ce19f8d.png

Rewards for Destroying Enemy Ships
Destroying enemy ships now grants random rewards based on their power and attributes, including:

 Ship parts of various types
 Money
 Research points
 4x increased rewards for clearing enemy camps

Shipyards and Shipbuilding Reworked
There are now three shipyard levels instead of two. Each new shipyard level unlocks more ship blueprints, but these require higher-quality parts, now divided into three types:

 Standard parts (Basic ships – Shipyard Level 1)
 Special parts (Advanced ships – Shipyard Level 2)
 Nuclear parts (Top-tier ships – Shipyard Level 3)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/deed47d65b1e83b4fdab4873b90b07b096cdc249.png

The shipyard interface has been redesigned:

 Compact part lists
 Researching new parts is now available directly from the shipyard UI
 Improved Research Tree
 The ship research branch has been moved to the shipyard UI.
 Shipyards and part factories have been moved to the main tech tree.

New Heavy Warship
Tempest – The largest ship available. It lacks a cargo hold but has:

 High durability
 3 upgrade slots
 6 weapon slots


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/9a9918abf60d4e811484d57f79dd45b43b478cc0.png

Multi-Ship Selection
You can now select multiple ships by dragging a selection box or holding Shift to issue a single command to multiple ships at once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/2c303076ddd6a0a9ba60bd8915f3ef595cf34400.png

Peaceful Mode
Based on player requests, you can now disable enemy ship spawns, enemy camps, and economic incidents when creating a game. This is perfect for those who want a peaceful gameplay experience.

However, in hard mode, enemy ships now deal twice as much damage, making them a real threat!

New Localizations

 Korean
 Italian
 Swedish

Other Improvements

 Water purifier redesigned;
 Polymer factory redesigned;
 Tier 2 polymer factory removed;
 New model for the transport hub;
 New small and medium parts factory models;
 New universal shipyard model, unlocking new part sets as corresponding factories are built;
 Medical lab model updated;
 Steel and titanium factories redesigned;
 Drone factory model optimized.
 Firewall model optimized.
 Targeting system fixed, preventing duplicate pact objectives
 Trade route suggestions refined
 Quest system backend improved
 Tutorial can now be closed with an X button
 Ultrawide (21:9) resolution support added
 Resource calculations sped up
 UI overflow issue fixed for players with more than 24 ships


I hope you enjoy this update! It was a lot of hard work to bring the game to its current stage, and I’m really exhausted, but I’m also very happy with the game! Your support means a lot to me—thank you for being here all this time! ❤️

notes.title: 0.9.7 – Colony Overview, Production Limits, Balance & Gameplay Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! ❤️

In this update, I’ve added a Colony Overview and production limits, along with a dozen fixes and improvements!

Colony Overview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/c99ea5060e18638caaefa53ab853b7d74d5b97cd.png
I received a lot of feedback requesting a colony overview, and now it’s finally here in this patch! The overview is generated from buildings connected to the Storage Network, so if you have two bases, you’ll see reports for each one separately. It includes details such as:

 Colony storage with production limits
 Energy networks
 Engineers overview, including average values and resource consumption
 Income, research progress, and spare parts production

Production Limits
In the colony overview, you can now set a resource limit for specific storage facilities. Each cycle, every factory checks whether the resource limit has been reached. If the limit is exceeded, the factory skips the cycle, freeing up engineers to work elsewhere.

Engineer Improvements

 Improved engineer profiles—stats are now clearer and more intuitive.
 Morale recovery algorithms have been optimized—once morale reaches the max limit, resources are no longer wasted.
 Fixed bugs in game logic and production multipliers that caused excessive resource production in buildings with multiple engineers.
 Increased motivation decay for engineers from 0.65 per rank to 1 per rank (on medium difficulty). Now, keeping engineers motivated is more challenging!
 Balanced and added display of consumed resources in units.
 Optimized internal algorithms for better performance.

Combat System Updates

 Decreased the interval between enemy waves.
 Accelerated the arrival of the first enemy wave.
 Increased weapon costs at the shipyard.

Other Gameplay Improvements

 Removed free containers—this mechanic disrupted storage logic, so now destroyed ships will consume resources instead.
 Economy update interval set to 9 seconds (3 sec in x3 speed). Previously, I increased it from 6 to 12 seconds, but in practice, it felt too slow.
 Multi-placement for blueprints—you can now place multiple buildings at once. Exit construction mode using right-click, Esc, or clicking the menu again.
 Tech tree progression rebalanced for a smoother development curve.
 Water factory construction costs adjusted—it now requires aluminum and ore instead of steel, as the previous cost made it significantly less viable than the basic factory.
 Fixed research order for the large Shipyard.

Bug Fixes

 Added a network availability check for buildings after generators are destroyed.
 Fixed a bug where the oil generator’s fuel consumption per cycle was missing from its description.
 Correct display of resource production in the built buildings' card.

What’s Next?
I’ll be testing the game for critical bugs over the next few days. If nothing major comes up, I’ll start working on update 0.10.0! It’s expected to take 3-4 weeks, as it will introduce new resources, buildings, and larger maps. I’ll keep you posted—see you soon! ❤️

notes.title: 0.9.6 🔥 Combat system, gameplay, engine, graphics, and performance improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

While the Steam strategy festival was underway, featuring Oasis Mission, I was hard at work developing this major update!
It consists of three parts:

 Combat system improvements
 General gameplay improvements
 Engine, graphics, and performance enhancements

I apologize for not being able to respond to everyone in the discussions yet. I really wanted to release this patch, as it significantly improves the game's feel, especially in combat. ❤️

Combat System
Ship Control

 Added missile range display.
 Holding the right mouse button allows you to set the ship's desired rotation, displaying the missile range if applicable.
 Ships now automatically turn toward their target to increase missile hit chances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/cff709a0538bbf6f7a2e48ab19edf01a6cad727f.png

Projectile Improvements

 Added smoke effects for projectiles.
 Projectiles will now fire if an enemy is within the damage area.
 New destruction animation for buildings.
 New destruction animation for ships.

New animation of projectiles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/7b46fc8323047df55c3da4e9b06f4fdd60ad14be.png
Old
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/0d3d17e20750a0c2ec971e885bee9bd64c44af59.png
New destruction animation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/d4e884eec2d8c983295df5b304f768eefc073d62.png
Old{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/eaf14fa2ece73c64a17e40ce01ef2cd6e7a0110b.png

Other Combat System Enhancements

 Increased the number of enemy waves by 20% and accelerated the arrival of initial waves. In existing games, previously generated waves (those shown in the timeline at the top) will retain the old timer, while new waves will generate faster.
 Clicking on an enemy ship makes your ship turn toward and attack it.
 Clicking on a friendly ship orders it to be repaired (if a repair module is available).
 Clicking on a friendly structure orders it to be repaired (if a repair module is available).


General Gameplay Improvements
Adaptive Events
Now, events depend on the state of your colony. Only events that impact the colony’s economy will occur. Additionally, the cost of a positive resolution now depends on the event's economic impact.

Other Gameplay Enhancements

 Fixed Mouse Pan getting stuck after interacting with a ship.
 Improved sound design for scene objects.
 Enhanced ship engine animations and sounds.
 A blackout now pauses ship activity without resetting all tasks. The ship resumes operations once protection is restored.
 Fixed incorrect ship destruction during resource gathering or construction.
 Proper destruction of residences—now engineers CORRECTLY (haha) die and STOP WORKING AFTER DEATH (haha) in factories.


Engine Improvements
Rendering Speed and Performance Boosts

 Reduced freezes by 90%.
 Improved rendering responsiveness.
 Reduced rendering latency.
 Smoother animations.
 Eliminated freezes when selecting a building location.
 Added LODs for terrain, reducing polygon count when zooming out or rendering shadows outside the main field of view.
 Replaced the landscape shader with a more universal projection shader, supporting more decorative variations in the future.
 Increased GPU performance.
 Fixed various rendering artifacts.
 Improved terrain loading, modification, and rendering performance.
 Enhanced shadow rendering quality by increasing the VRAM buffer size.
 Fixed incorrect terrain deformations at landscape chunk junctions.
 Landscape collision calculations are now 15 times faster.


Instance Scene Composer

 Enabled multithreading for the 3D scene instance composer.
 Optimized and accelerated the instance composer.


I hope you enjoy the update and encounter minimal bugs! Either way, I’ll be actively monitoring feedback and promptly fixing any issues, as well as reviewing the errors you reported this week.

Thank you all so much for your support! ❤️

notes.title: 0.9.6-0.10.0 – Announcement of Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/e73fc22ea5802925bfe04a0dae3aa223048c7947.png

Hello everyone! I want to share my plans for the upcoming updates!

First of all, I can see that the last three updates have made the game much more intuitive, and the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive! I’m incredibly happy and grateful for that!

I really liked the storage connection system—it makes developing a large base much more enjoyable and simplifies resource management since everything is drawn from a unified network.

Many of the future improvements are based on your feedback!

0.10.0
Map Size Increase and New Resources
I plan to add new large maps in 0.10.0 and new resources. The idea is that the increased map size will encourage players to establish a second colony, which will require setting up a resource exchange system.

Resource deposits will be distributed in a way that allows the first colony to function independently for about 1-2 in-game hours. After that, players will hit a resource shortage necessary for progression and will have to venture out to find and extract them.

These maps will be 4-5 times larger than the current ones, meaning resources will be located at significant distances. This is where trade routes and cargo ships will become truly essential!

Additionally, I plan to introduce a maximum extraction limit per area or source to encourage players to establish new mining outposts.

0.9.6-0.9.7
Direct Ship Control
I’m working on adding manual control over a ship’s altitude and rotation using the mouse. This will be especially useful in combat since missile ballistics depend on height and ship orientation.

Damage Area Visualization
For combat ships, I plan to introduce a radial damage zone that will display the approximate trajectory of different missile types. For example:
- Heavy missiles fly almost in a straight line.
- Light missiles can curve up to 300 degrees.

Click-to-Target Commands
Clicking on an enemy ship will make your ship turn towards it and fire missiles if possible.
Clicking on a friendly ship will activate repair modules if available.
And so on.

Projectile Behavior Improvements
Right now, weapons fire regardless of whether the shot is likely to hit. I plan to implement a simple targeting system so ships only fire when there’s a reasonable chance of hitting the target.

Additionally, I plan to improve missile animations, add smoke trails, and make explosions and ship destruction more epic.

Colony Overview
From player feedback, I noticed that many would like an overview of production and engineer status in the colony. I plan to add this feature.

Resource Production Limits
I’ll add a resource production limit setting for storage networks to prevent overproduction of any single resource.

Routes Optimization
I also plan to improve trade routes so that ships seek return cargo when traveling between two bases.

Performance Enhancements
Depending on your PC’s power, you may experience frame drops due to CPU delays in adjacent threads. This is especially noticeable on the Steam Deck, where frame tearing occurs almost constantly when moving the camera. I want to find a way to fix this.

Resource Display Improvements
There’s currently some confusion in how resources are displayed on the map. I plan to refine this.

And many More Small Improvements! I will do my best to implement all of these enhancements by February-March 2025.

notes.title: 0.9.5 – ❤️‍🔥 Hot Update! Storage Network, Work Areas Rework, Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In this update, I’ve significantly reworked the storage system, work areas, and made several other improvements. I believe this update has made the game more intuitive and much less confusing!

A huge thanks to everyone for your feedback and suggestions, which greatly helped in designing this update!

Storages Network:
When constructing storage buildings, their work area (130 meters) will be displayed. Storages within this radius can be linked into a single network once both buildings are fully constructed and connected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/97f3caaf906f8ef31d6a4ce9f61ff308298a5a76.png

After linking, a special connector storage is built between the two. Note: There must be no other buildings between the linked storages to establish the connection.

A unified storage network sums up the total capacity and resources of all connected storages. This means that buildings connected to the network won’t need to figure out which specific storage to pull resources from or where to place finished products.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/1e992371a19a4a892ef12dcbac6db26800dc2222.jpg

Building Work Area Improvements:
In previous versions, players had separate work areas for "Storages" and "Engineers", which overlapped with "Power" and "Resources" areas. This created excessive visual clutter, making it difficult to understand what was going on.

Now, all buildings have one large work area (700 meters) within which they can connect and interact with other buildings. The work area is outlined with a thick border, preventing it from visually conflicting with other zones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/2ee8ce234e2361bff58bc472dce99fc51d806e4a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/d90dd9a5bae6745a672973018195a484ff2c47c8.jpg

Ship Behavior with Storages Network:
When transporting resources, ships will automatically head to the nearest storage in the network or to a specific one if you manually choose it.

By expanding your storage network with new connection nodes, you can reduce traffic jams caused by ships queuing up at storages!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/acf2690c612402e4406d1e7c47b7673c0663f000.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/f6281b67aaf9a495e64cfc5b391c810428fdd0ee.jpg

Other Fixes and Improvements:

 Fixed bugs that likely caused game freezes during building construction for mission tasks. Other bugs that could cause crashes were also fixed.
 Fixed several performance leaks.
 Fixed an issue where the color of a newly built ship wouldn’t apply to its icon in the UI.
 Fixed incorrect ship icons displaying in route lists.
 Improved the contrast of highlighted elements.
 Improved responsiveness when selecting buildings.
 Fixed a bug where the building's work area would lag behind the building’s movement during construction.
 Fixed the progress display for ore extraction objectives.

Enjoy the update, and keep the feedback coming! ❤️

notes.title: 0.9.4 - Ships AI, Economic & UI Improvements, Performance Fixes
notes.content:
Hello! In this update, I focused on enhancing the AI and behavioral patterns of ships, improving the user interface, fixing performance issues, and implementing improvements based on your feedback!

Storage System Rework Announcement
The storage system has received the most critical feedback so far. It’s clear that it needs significant adjustments. I've gathered all your suggestions, and I’ll start working on the storage mechanics overhaul in the next patch!

Major Fixes for Memory and CPU Leaks
There were serious memory and CPU leaks caused by the animation and time interpolation library I use. In the new version of this library, expired functions weren’t being properly cleared, leading to unnecessary code execution. Fixing this issue has significantly improved performance during the late stages of the game.

Ships AI Improvements:

 Improved behavior patterns for construction ships — they now take resources in bulk, with optimized algorithms for efficiency.
 Fixed an issue with the repair module ship’s behavior pattern.
 Enhanced task search and task memory algorithms for ships.
 Fixed issues where ships would switch between tasks or become confused.
 Fixed bugs where ships became idle without performing any tasks.
 Fixed a bug where ships took control away from the player and didn’t move to the designated point.
 Fixed an issue where construction ships wouldn’t unload into storage or only used a portion of the storage compartments for required resources.
 Optimized AI algorithms for better performance.
 Improved responsiveness of ships to tasks and player commands.
 Mining, delivery, and construction abilities can now be manually activated when directing a ship to a specific target.

Economic Adjustments:

 Extended the economic cycle interval from 6 to 12 seconds (or 4 seconds at x3 speed) to reduce information overload for players.
 Improved the economic cycle timer to ensure consistent production values between cycles without decimal deviations.

UI Improvements:

 Added and improved tooltips in the route interface, with various bug fixes.
 Grouped ships by color in the bottom menu for better visual clarity.
 Color selection for future buildings and ships is now saved across sessions.
 Ship and building colors will persist after saving and loading the game.
 Various small UI improvements and bug fixes.
 Fixed an issue where players would get confused when trying to purchase blueprints if the interface rounded their balance up to a higher value than they actually had.
 Improved the ship upgrade experience — now, the ship editing interface opens immediately, without needing to wait for the ship to move to the shipyard.


Many of these changes were directly influenced by player feedback, and more improvements are planned for upcoming patches. Thank you for your support and feedback!

notes.title: 0.9.3 – VSync, Translations, Improvements, and Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In this update, I’ve made many improvements, including some based on your feedback!

Game Time, Performance:

 Added an algorithm that limits economy updates and animation calculations to no more than 90 times per second. This helps reduce CPU and RAM usage for players with over 90 FPS.
 Improved game time interpolation to smooth out animations and calculations during occasional freezes, if they occur.
 Fixed bugs where the displayed game speed was incorrect or didn't update properly.

Game Menu and Settings (Esc):

 Added the ability to change settings during gameplay.
 Added a camera reset option in the menu.
 Added a mouse sensitivity setting.
 Added a keyboard control sensitivity setting.
 Vertical sync (VSync) is now enabled by default, with an option to toggle it on or off.

Pacts and Objectives:

 Fixed objective behavior — objectives now shuffle automatically after a selection is made.
 Fixed an issue where the objective order would randomly change when the objective selection window was opened.

Other Improvements:

 Improved translation quality.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the game from launching when Steam was disabled.
 Slightly improved task rotation and task quality.

Thank you all for your support and feedback! Keep sharing your thoughts!

notes.title: 0.9.1 – Ship Engine Animations, Start Guide, Fixes, and New Post-Process Shader
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
❤️ Thank you so much for your support and feedback! I’m incredibly grateful to you all! ❤️

Post-Processing Shader

notes.title: 0.9.0 - Trade, Routes, Strategic Pacts, Diplomacy, Objectives, Events & Waves
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm thrilled to share this fantastic update! In it, I managed to finalize most of the planned mechanics, and their implementation is as close to ideal as possible!

For example, I prototyped the trade mechanic about eight times over two years, but now it's finally perfect! Interestingly, your feedback in discussions about routes played a huge role. Essentially, I just created routes with other factions! It's simple yet brilliant, and, most importantly, easy for players to understand, as visually, these are almost two identical mechanics.

Foreword and Gratitude
Right now, the game looks better than ever! I can hardly believe I developed it alone, inspired by your feedback! Without your input, the game would have turned out very differently, so I want you to appreciate the value of your contributions!

I see that some things still need polishing—new maps, ships, and modules need to be added—but the main pool and core mechanics are ready. Perhaps I could also add area-based active abilities.

Strategic Pacts
These are essentially powerful laws and decrees that affect the entire colony. Some pacts provide temporary improvements, while others offer permanent benefits. Certain pacts have negative effects to balance them out.

Their key strength lies in how they subtly allow you to control the pace and gameplay, crafting your own story and game modes. At the same time, they add a role-playing element to managing your colony!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/74e12938eb8473cb510739864e232331b0a26934.png

Strategic Objectives
These are goals presented to you at random for you to choose from. They allow you to take on situational tasks that bring additional rewards, enhancing variety and immersion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/473fc8b9283a6f4b5230927582c2f626a3efa781.png

Routes
A much-requested feature by many players! You can now configure routes between storage facilities and set conditions for resource transportation. Amusingly, I implemented it almost exactly as you described in the discussions!

Ships make transport decisions based on the settings you provide!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/88ae02cc9b4dd09bbb66d68dff504737aff4474b.png

Trade
I used the route pattern to create a trade system with other colonies. Essentially, it’s a similar system to routes, but it involves ships from the outside world, with your trade partner located off-map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/1ed459490a63f794967a3d669ab9769339b550b0.png

You can purchase trade routes and configure them to maximize profits—or even become a trade company yourself, earning by reselling resources!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/36203efb26f038f1401622048ce605abdc0ed337.png

Events
I replaced pop-up notifications with Events. Initially, it’s still a pop-up, but now it requires opening, and sometimes you can make situational decisions based on your economy.

Events will occur in a different order in every playthrough, ensuring unique challenges and opportunities for adaptation each time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/b30f188281ac7f3af680f8c04ed7ddffaec8ee26.png

Engineer Departures
Engineers now leave the colony in a controlled manner, and you can even bribe them to stay! Every 15 minutes (approximately two in-game months), they decide whether to leave or remain. The lower the morale level (starting from 30), the higher the chance they'll leave.

When they decide to go, you’ll encounter an Event that gives you one last chance to convince them to stay.

New Wave and Hacking System
These systems have been improved to make them more predictable and to allow interaction with other systems, like pacts or events.

The core mechanics remain the same, but the design and technical implementation have been enhanced, making them suitable for longer gameplay sessions.

Ship Memory
Ships now remember where they’ve been sent before and can recall objects. For instance, they’ll associate themselves with a specific storage for loading items or a specific mining site for ore. Target icons have also been added to action buttons, making it clearer what and where a ship will perform its task.

Other Improvements

 Save system enhancements
 Interface optimizations
 Improved sound design
 Fixed interface bugs
 Fixed a rare issue where models would flicker

I hope you encounter as few bugs as possible, but if you do come across anything, please report it in the discussions!

notes.title: Announcement 0.9.0! Strategic Pacts, Objectives, Global Abilities, and Events!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you so much for your support, and a special thanks to StellarWolf for your incredible involvement in testing!

I’m excited to announce the start of development on Patch 0.9.0! In this update, I’ve taken into account players’ feedback and issues, and I’ve come up with ways to make the game even better. It will follow Patch 0.8.5, which will focus on fixing existing bugs.

The goal of this update is to make the gameplay more personal and unique! Shape the story to fit your own style!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/4e225720a0cec51d0272301abf95b5da9e9bee52.png
Strategic Pacts and Objectives
Inspired by tabletop games and recent strategies like Dune and Against the Storm, I’ve developed the mechanics of Pacts and Objectives. These are powerful abilities that can dramatically change the course of the game!

Pacts, objectives, and their slots will be unlockable through the abilities tree. A pact slot will require a LONG cooldown but deliver a POWERFUL effect, which can be either passive or active. An objective slot will require specific conditions to activate and recharge.

For example, you can drastically reduce the threat of ship attacks, but at the cost of bonuses to your economy, factories, engineers, or research speed!

Economic Events and Engineer Resignations
Currently, economic events and engineer resignations often happen in the background, with little player involvement.

In the new version, I plan to give players more control and options. Each event will come with multiple crisis management decisions. You’ll also gain an overview of colonists planning to leave and be able to persuade them to stay by offering counter-proposals.

Money and Global/Orbital Abilities
Engineers will generate income through taxes. This money can be spent on orbital strikes, support ships, supplies, summoning trade ships, and more.

I can’t wait to share this update with you in December!
I hope it all comes together just as I imagine!

notes.title: 0.8.2 - UX and Audio Improvements, Balancing, RAM & loading optimizations
notes.content:
This update significantly reduces VRAM and RAM usage, resulting in improved rendering speed responsiveness. It also fixes some loading issues with certain textures and objects.

Difficulty and Intensity Adjustments
In new games, the intervals before the first wave of hacks and enemies, as well as between waves at all difficulty levels, have been increased by 30%. This adjustment makes it easier for players to manage time and eases the early game experience on lower difficulty levels.

Playlist Intensity
The playlist is now divided into three groups: low, medium, and high intensity, with tracks selected based on in-game events to match the atmosphere.

Energy Network
The logic of the power networks has been fixed. Now, battery charge can reach 100% if energy generation is sufficient to cover the last cycle's operational costs of the factories.

New Ship Ability - Cargo Drop
Drop the ship's cargo into a container to clear the overloaded compartment. This is useful in case the compartment is blocked due to unnecessary resources piling up early in the game.

Other Changes
- The base radius of industrial ships has been slightly increased to avoid issues in hard-to-reach areas.
- Building construction is canceled when the construction menu is closed.
- Improved sound design for some UI elements.

notes.title: 0.8.0 - Firewall, Rise of the Machines, Rework colonist system
notes.content:
In this update, I’ve added combat mechanics with resistance to the machine uprising and completely reworked the colonist system! Additionally, I've introduced the option to choose a backstory, which unlocks certain blueprints available in later stages of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/d28b7035563345b46217439288aadcb6256c0304.png

Oblivion Network Uprising
Once launched on a quantum supercomputer, a certain neural network instantly surpassed all known learning curves and managed to gain control over all known security protocols.

Bits in quantum processors can be in a state of superposition, representing both 0 and 1 simultaneously, which enabled the AI to achieve an instant and human-uncontrolled rate of learning and spread across the network.

You will need to protect your fleet and colonies using the Firewall network to prevent losing control and withstand waves of machines led by the Oblivion network that has rebelled against humanity.

Firewall
Oblivion enslaves the systems of your ships and buildings. Build antennas, radars, servers, and stations to protect your colony’s territory, but keep in mind that Oblivion constantly increases its power and finds new ways to attack.

Oblivion Attacks
Oblivion sends enslaved ships to your colony. You’ll need to assemble your combat fleet to resist these attacks.

Economic Crises
Global crises and cataclysms now trigger specific events that impact your colony and the motivation of your engineers. During these moments, your economy will face a true test of endurance.

Reworked Colonist System
    Engineers now have their own backstory and morale level, which can be replenished by consuming water, various supplies, and medicine.    Engineers arrive at special hubs, from where they need to be assigned to residences.    Likewise, engineers may choose to leave the colony via a transport hub and refuse to work. Your ships will need to transport them to the hub, otherwise, unemployed engineers will consume resources.    Engineers lose morale while working and return to the residence when it reaches 0.    If an engineer has to work without rest, the chance of them leaving the colony increases proportionally.
Backstory Selection
When starting a game, you can now choose your governing backstory, as well as the difficulty level of economic crises and resistance against Oblivion.

1 Map - 1 Game
A tough decision was made to disable map transitions within a single session, to focus on a cohesive gameplay experience within one map and deepen the game mechanics.

Other Improvements

Dynamic Quests
Tasks are now issued dynamically, based on the state and pace of your colony’s development.

New Generator
Generates energy from oil.

Repair Module
For repairing ships and buildings, but it cannot repair itself.

Improved Material Loading
Fixed some stuttering during material and shader loading. The game and map loading algorithms have been improved.

UI Design
The main menu, quests, ship, item, and building cards have been redesigned. Minor improvements have also been made to other elements.

Map Design
New resource spots have been added, and the environment and lighting design have been improved.

Thank you so much for your ideas! I’ll be responding to all comments and suggestions over the next day or two.

Photorealistic Soft Lighting
Inspired by the Cyberpunk 2077 Photorealistic mod, I’ve developed a similar lighting version optimized for RTS. I’m still maintaining the minimum standard of 60 FPS on an RTX 4060 at 4K resolution.

Automatic Engineer Assignment
Engineers are now automatically assigned to available slots upon arrival or when a new factory is built.

Ship AI Improvements
- Added a new behavior model, "Shipping," which automatically delivers resources to the nearest warehouse, such as offloading ore after mining. The warehouse’s effective range for factories has been doubled to reduce early-game inconvenience.
- Fixed bugs that caused ships to stop executing tasks.

Screen UI Notifications Removed
With the gameplay overhaul, screen notifications have become unnecessary. Issues such as "Overloaded Ship," "No Resources," or unassigned engineers are now resolved through automation, expanded warehouse range, and the new "Shipping" ability for ships.

The size of the red beams above buildings has been increased to draw more attention precisely where needed.

Environment
- Improved environment on the very first map, adding birds and fish.
- Enhanced the balance between environmental sounds and music.
- Reduced the propagation distance of object sounds by 15%.

UI Optimization: 800% Reduction in CPU Load
Eliminated the background process tracking library in favor of manual management.

Hitbox and Ship Route Optimization
Optimized hitbox analysis and ship pathfinding, reducing CPU load by 20-30 times and improving movement trajectories.

Rendering Optimization
Reduced GPU load by 25% and improved frame rendering request flow on the CPU side, reducing the number of missed frames.

Z-Fighting Resolved
Completely resolved Z-Fighting issues using a logarithmic buffer, which previously caused textures to overlap incorrectly.

Game Loading Improvements
Reduced required RAM and CPU tasks, speeding up game loading times.

Other Changes:
- Increased wind generator range by 50%.
- All generators now produce 50% more energy.
- Fixed an issue where the ship icon didn’t change when swapping hulls.

notes.title: Self review, ideas and gameplay grooming
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/4de69e17a5dbff7d3e53aaf7ed13e0002c9bf80a.png

Thank you very much for your feedback, support, and responses! Recently, the game received the necessary number of reviews for the recommendation system, and I am incredibly grateful to you!

In this review, I want to share general feedback from players and ideas that will improve the game:

Too Many Notifications with Warnings
The overly noticeable design of notifications in the UI disrupts the game flow. Additionally, there can be an overwhelming number of notifications. I've found a few solutions to this problem:

Automatic Assignment of Engineers
Is it really necessary for the player to manually assign each engineer? It seems that automatically assigning engineers could eliminate the unnecessary "Engineer Not Assigned" notification.

Insufficient Resources and Overfilled Cargo Holds
Some factories require resources on a regular basis, while overfilled ships simply stop mining ore. Clearly, mining ships should automatically deliver resources to the appropriate warehouse. This would eliminate two types of notifications: "Overfilled Cargo Hold" and the recurring "Insufficient Resources."

Low Ship Energy
It might be better to reduce the ship's efficiency in a more immersive way, without special notifications. Perhaps add some indicators on the ship that attract attention, such as red lights.

Resource Logistics and Ship AI
I want to place more emphasis on logistics and resource transportation, creating a situation where the player establishes "logistics routes" for the ships. To achieve this, the ship AI will need to be improved so that the player can set resource transportation patterns for them.

Bugs with Ship AI
Currently, there are unfortunate situations where ships lose their tasks and remain idle, which will be fixed.

Conclusion
Before the next major update, I want to address these issues and release several improvements to the graphics and engine.

As early as next month, I plan to start implementing combat encounters, which will bring new depth to the existing mechanics!

notes.title: Massive Update 0.7.0! All game mechanics and systems have been improved!
notes.content:
I’m thrilled to announce the release of our most significant update yet: Version 0.7.0! This update brings a comprehensive overhaul to all game systems, introducing new features, improvements, and refinements to enhance your gaming experience!

Of course, such a major update needs to be released with a new game trailer featuring the updated key mechanics! You can watch it on the game’s page or on YouTube:

[previewyoutube=HQ4k2dP5drk;full][/previewyoutube]

Updates:

 Improved save and load system:
    
     Progress is now saved for each map, allowing you to develop multiple colonies simultaneously  
     Moving between maps is now transition within the game
    
 Photo mode
 Interface and UX Improvements:
    
     Complete redesign of the game’s interface for a more intuitive user experience.
     Refactoring of the editor and its areas to streamline design and editing processes.
     New click-action with the right mouse button on objects, making interactions quicker and easier.
     In-game display of the technology tree with a redesigned layout for better visibility and navigation.
    
 Shipbuilding and Resource Management:
    
     Introducing the Shipyard where you can now build new ships, utilizing quantum cores as a primary resource.
     Expansion of shipyard levels and blueprints to support the construction of advanced vessels.
     Removed unnecessary game item storage from corporations and cargo ships, streamlining inventory management.
     New universal laser tool and updated ship-to-ship transfer system for more efficient resource handling.
    
 Missions and Quests:
    
     Enhanced mission selection and ship customization, ensuring smooth transitions between tasks.
     Reworked quest system with blueprint quests and mission-specific saves, providing a more focused and rewarding gameplay experience.
    
 Mining and Construction Overhaul:
    
     Infinite mining introduced, with a rework of mining mechanics and clearer resource identification.
     Construction system rework, including notifications for insufficient resources and energy block refactoring.
     New models for ore and aluminum mining shafts, alongside small and medium factories for parts, medical supplies, bots, and special uniforms.
    
 Additional Features:
    
     Steam Cloud integration for seamless progress saving across devices.
     New global map presented as octagons with screenshots for a visually engaging navigation experience.
     Enhanced photo mode, sound effects for building interactions, and color grading with LUTs for a more immersive visual experience.
    

This update marks a major step forward in the evolution of our game, providing you with new tools, systems, and challenges to conquer. I excited to see how you’ll leverage these upgrades to build, explore, and dominate the universe!

Update your game now and dive into the massive changes brought by Version 0.7.0!

notes.title: 0.6.5 - Instance & Audio Compositor. New ship cargo UI. Performance improvement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721340/1c1c45018111714f9501b799dd7d5f31ac73fc40.png

An extensive improvement has been made to the game engine "Instance & Audio Compositor." This is a compositor for 3D scenes and audio environments operating in an independent CPU thread. This significantly reduced latency and load on the main process, making the visuals smoother and increasing FPS.

Audio assets have been added for buildings, the rustling of leaves, and laser sounds when the camera zooms in.

Other improvements:

 Optimized camera movement, reducing CPU load.
 Display of cargo contents in the cargo hold above the ship.
 Optimized ship rendering.
 Added highlight for the ship under the cursor.
 Improved display of building action areas. Now circles do not overlap but merge into one zone. The rendering pipeline for areas has been optimized.
 Fixed a bug where selecting ships and buildings did not work in the first few seconds.
 Removed erroneous requirement for building on groundwater for the "Plant food factory."
 Reduced stuttering due to rendering pipeline optimization.
 Added a button to the game menu: Exit to Desktop.


The next update will likely be 0.7.0 and will touch many aspects of gameplay, including the complete overhaul of the following:

 Complete overhaul of mining.
 Complete overhaul of ship modifications.
 Complete overhaul of research.
 Overhaul of maps and missions.
 This will lead to a save wipe.
